description: This file defines a PHP class 'ShippingMethod' in the Opencart e-commerce framework, responsible for handling checkout shipping method actions such as displaying available shipping methods, quoting, and saving selected shipping info.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Handles shipping method related interactions during checkout process in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping method selection view, populating data from session and configuration.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Provides shipping quotes based on the cart and shipping address, returning JSON response.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method to the session after validation, returning JSON response.
